subtitle_ja: A transparent funnel model for estimating AI adoption.

layers.formula_ja: N_dev = sum(developer AI tool users) * (1 - developer tool overlap)
layers.rationale_ja: Developer workflow usage is the strongest adoption signal and is removed first.
layers.risk_ja: Work accounts, personal accounts, and multi-tool usage can overlap.

layers.formula_ja: N_pro = sum(ARR_i / annual ARPU) * (1 - paid overlap) - developer overlap
layers.rationale_ja: ARR is used as a proxy when paid user counts are not disclosed.
layers.risk_ja: ARR can mix consumer, enterprise, and API revenue.

layers.formula_ja: N_free = sum(MAU_i * unique user factor_i) - upper-layer overlap
layers.rationale_ja: Free users are estimated from traffic and app usage proxies.
layers.risk_ja: Visits are not users, and multi-homing can inflate the estimate.

layers.formula_ja: N_passive = eligible devices * availability * activation - explicit overlap
layers.rationale_ja: OS-level AI creates passive exposure outside standalone AI apps.
layers.risk_ja: Eligible devices do not guarantee actual use.

layers.formula_ja: N_unreached = N_total - N_dev - N_pro - N_free - N_passive
layers.rationale_ja: Unreached users are the residual after exclusive assignment.
layers.risk_ja: All upstream estimation errors flow into this residual.
